optimizedCv.targetRoleTitle: Rollout Project Manager, Warehouse Robotics Deployment

professionalSummary.text: Seasoned rollout manager with nine successful go-lives of goods‑to‑person robotics across diverse warehouse environments, overseeing cut‑over, hypercare, and closure reporting.
professionalSummary.witness: Took nine customer warehouses live on the goods-to-person robotics system between 2021 and 2025, running the cut-over from manual picking at each site over a weekend and the first live picking shift on the Monday morning.

experienceHighlights.text: Executed nine site cut‑overs from manual picking to live robotics, coordinating with field engineering and customer operations to ensure seamless transition.
experienceHighlights.witness: Took nine customer warehouses live on the goods-to-person robotics system between 2021 and 2025, running the cut-over from manual picking at each site over a weekend and the first live picking shift on the Monday morning.

experienceHighlights.text: Led a two‑week hypercare period post‑go‑live, managing stoppages reported by shift leaders and maintaining detailed logs of causes and resolutions.
experienceHighlights.witness: Ran the hypercare fortnight at all nine sites with the customer's shift leaders and handled the stoppages raised during hypercare; the stoppage log for each site records the cause, the fix and who cleared it.

experienceHighlights.text: Conducted pre‑go‑live acceptance testing with customers, securing signed acceptance records from operations managers before cut‑over.
experienceHighlights.witness: Ran the pre-go-live acceptance tests with the customer on the installed system at each site, with the acceptance record signed by the customer's operations manager before cut-over.

experienceHighlights.text: Authored comprehensive site closure reports detailing limitations, open items, and hand‑over conditions.
experienceHighlights.witness: Wrote the site closure report for each warehouse, listing the known limitations of the system at that site, the open items for remote support and the hand-over conditions agreed with the customer.

projectsAndWorkSamples.text: Provided a complete go‑live and hypercare plan, stoppage log, signed acceptance record, and closure report for the most recent site, with verifiable site numbers.
projectsAndWorkSamples.witness: Work sample: the go-live and hypercare plan for the most recent site, its stoppage log, the signed acceptance record and the site closure report, with the site numbers as a verification trail.

skills.text: Project management, schedule coordination, acceptance testing, incident handling, documentation
